The rule: with no action word, use am, is or are.
Right: "The giraffe is very tall."
Wrong: "The giraffe very tall." There is no action word and no is, so the sentence is not complete.
I think aloud: "The zebra is black and white."
First, I look for an action word. There is none.
Next, who is it about? The zebra, one animal, so it.
Then, it takes is.
Your turn. Write only the missing word:
I ___ a student.
